summary: The note describes Guangling District, one of three districts of Yangzhou in Jiangsu province, China. It covers the eastern half of Yangzhou's main urban area, including the historic center within the former city wall, along with the city's eastern suburbs. The western half of the main urban area lies in Hanjiang District.
one_line: Guangling District is one of three districts of Yangzhou, Jiangsu, covering the eastern half of the urban area and eastern suburbs.
